name: nanoodle
description: Saved or agent-composed nanoodle workflows as MCP tools: BYOK, pay per call in Nano, or pay in NEAR

extensions.description: Live wire protocol at the declared interface is MCP (streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC). This card is published for discovery; an A2A task-submission interface is not live yet and is not claimed here.

skills.name: Run a saved nanoodle workflow
skills.description: Run a workflow graph saved from the nanoodle.com editor (or a nanoodle.com share link) as a single tool call: multi-model text, image, video, audio and 3D pipelines executed end to end, with the result returned to the caller.
examples: Run this nanoodle share link with the prompt 'a lighthouse at dusk, painterly'
Run my saved 'product-shot' workflow on this photo

skills.name: Compose and run a custom workflow
skills.description: Compose a workflow graph inline (text → image → video chains and branches over the NanoGPT model catalog), get a free itemized price, pay per run, and receive the result. Custom composition is a NEAR-rail feature.
examples: Build a workflow that turns this paragraph into an illustration, then a 5-second clip
Price a custom graph before I commit to running it

skills.name: Price a workflow before running it
skills.description: Free, itemized per-node quote for a saved or composed workflow, with a 30-minute validity window on the NEAR rail. No payment is taken for a quote.
examples: What would this workflow cost to run?
Give me an itemized price for this graph
